description: This PHP source file defines the 'DBVerifierCommand' class, a console command for performing various database maintenance and verification tasks within the Goteo project. It includes methods for configuring the command, executing database cleanup operations such as removing old feed entries, tokens, mails, blocked users, and running database integrity checks and predictions.

classes.name: DBVerifierCommand
classes.description: A console command class for performing database verification and cleanup tasks, including removing old records and checking database integrity.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, arguments, and help text for the CLI command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the database verification and cleanup operations based on input options and arguments, including removing old feed entries, tokens, mails, blocked users, and running integrity checks and predictions.
